mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals strengthening economic demand, which typically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of periods following sustained GDP growth, or GDP growth and SPX returns show a negative correlation over a 5-year rolling window (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business confidence decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% over two months signals a supply-side contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as production slowdowns impact corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between INDPRO decreases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% over two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which typically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as related industries benefit.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between HOUST increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and CPI inflation is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with high inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real returns are eroded.
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 over a month and the unemployment rate decreases, the combination signals a strengthening labor market, which typically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending improve.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k in 1 month and UNRATE decreases
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail and food services sales by more than 1% over two months signals strengthening consumer demand, which typically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods following sustained RSAFS growth, or RSAFS growth and SPX returns show a negative correlation over a 3-year rolling window (p < 0.05).
